Race_or_Hazard_Prevented: Torn reads where a file is modified by another process while its bytes are being read
Failure_and_Recovery_Behavior: Retries up to 5 attempts if before.Version != after.Version or size exceeds limit; returns errs.ErrTimeout if continuously mutating

Race_or_Hazard_Prevented: Lost updates (ABA clobbering), partial/torn files on crash, and path traversal via symlinks or ..
Failure_and_Recovery_Behavior: Resolves via os.Root; writes sibling .part temp file, fsyncs file, renames into place, and fsyncs parent dir; returns -32062 rpc.conflict on mismatch

Race_or_Hazard_Prevented: Client re-sending a non-idempotent write when rename succeeded but post-write stat failed
Failure_and_Recovery_Behavior: Returns -32066 rpc.committed with empty version; instructs client to doc.read and compare rather than blindly retrying

Race_or_Hazard_Prevented: Concurrent agent task edits, duplicate task IDs across buckets, or half-completed moves/deletes on crash
Failure_and_Recovery_Behavior: Rejects stale rev with -32071 todos.stale; recovers pending/staged journal rows on next store open before serving writes

Race_or_Hazard_Prevented: Missing filesystem events that occur while the initial directory walk (reconcile) is still running
Failure_and_Recovery_Behavior: Subscribes watcher (w.Watch) first, runs full reconcile('.') second, and drains queued events third; falls back to polling/degraded backoff on error

Race_or_Hazard_Prevented: Two daemons corrupting autodoc.db or serving divergent indexes over different sockets
Failure_and_Recovery_Behavior: Acquires exclusive flock on lease file, verifies (device, inode) identity, and publishes lease-info; second --serve exits 0 or refuses foreign socket

Race_or_Hazard_Prevented: SQLITE_BUSY lock contention and interleaved multi-table transactions
Failure_and_Recovery_Behavior: Serializes all database writes through one writer connection while concurrent search.query and graph reads run in parallel

Race_or_Hazard_Prevented: Pipelined client verbs executing before protocol negotiation completes or running at wrong protocol version
Failure_and_Recovery_Behavior: Serializes a session's early requests behind its in-flight sys.hello (up to 3s); gates every verb against session protocol vs Contract.Since

Race_or_Hazard_Prevented: Stale async RPC responses overwriting newer UI state after a reconnect, workspace switch, or buffer change
Failure_and_Recovery_Behavior: Ticket.Current() checks sequence counter plus TicketSession (session.Gen), TicketWorkspace (h.epoch), TicketFile (h.active + file.gen), or TicketLocal
